name: Bentwood bistro chair
parts: looped back hoop that forms the back legs
round seat ring with beaded rim
two front legs tapering to the floor
small brass-less screws at the joints
style: Viennese cafe chair, dark walnut stain, satin lacquer worn on the hoop top
summary: Bentwood bistro chair after Thonet No. 14: steam-bent beech hoop back, splayed legs, leg ring, woven cane seat.
